items.definition:
sweat.
Beads of perspiration formed on his forehead.

the act of playing through a video game from start to finish.
I watched a full playthrough of the new game online.

a person who tries to please others.
She's such a people-pleaser, always trying to make everyone happy.

a person or group in whose name an insurance policy is held.
The insurance company sent a notice to all policyholders.

a person who is easily persuaded or influenced.
Don't be a pushover; stand up for yourself.

the number of passengers
Public transport ridership increased during the fuel crisis.

Bigfoot; a large, hairy, ape-like creature
Many people claim to have seen a Sasquatch in the wilderness.

a former British coin worth six pennies
He found an old sixpence coin in the garden.

a member of a subculture characterized by a shaven head and anti-establishment views
The documentary explored the history of the skinhead movement.

a building for storing goods
The old factory was converted into a large storehouse.

a follower of Taoism
A Taoist seeks harmony with nature.

the windpipe
Air passes through the trachea to reach the lungs.

short for trigonometry
I have a trig test tomorrow.

a thin, wispy piece or amount
A wisp of smoke curled up from the campfire.

an animal between one and two years old
The young horse, a yearling, galloped across the field.

a Japanese martial art
She practices Aikido twice a week to improve her discipline.

a word, phrase, or name formed by rearranging the letters of another
'Listen' is an anagram of 'silent'.

railway; path
The Autobahn is famous for its lack of speed limits in some sections.

the lowest part of a ship's hull; nonsense
The pump was used to clear water from the bilge.

a risk of exposure to biological material that could cause harm
The laboratory had clear signs indicating a biohazard area.

short trousers fastened just below the knee
The horse rider wore traditional riding breeches.

A device or program that encodes or decodes a digital data stream or signal.
The video file requires a specific codec to play correctly.

The state of living together and having a sexual relationship without being married.
Cohabitation is becoming more common before marriage.

An item that is used up or consumed.
Office supplies are considered consumables.

The process of cleaning something to destroy bacteria.
Proper disinfection is crucial in hospitals.

A person who studies the relationships between living organisms and their environment.
An ecologist presented findings on climate change.

The state of being in danger or at risk.
The new law aims to prevent the endangerment of rare species.

clarified butter, especially that used in Indian cooking
She cooked the curry with ghee.

the force of attraction between all masses in the universe
Newton's law of universal gravitation explains why apples fall.

the monetary unit of Denmark, Norway, and other countries
The price of the souvenir was 50 Danish krone.

a deep cut or tear in skin or flesh
He received a deep laceration on his arm from the broken glass.

A person who habitually expresses negative or pessimistic views.
Don't listen to the naysayers; believe in your own abilities.

An active participant in the online community.
The netizen expressed their opinion in the online forum.

A doctor specializing in childbirth and the care of women during pregnancy.
The pregnant woman had an appointment with her obstetrician.

A member of a Pashto-speaking people inhabiting southern Afghanistan and northwestern Pakistan.
The Pashtun people have a rich cultural heritage.

A person who tends to see the worst aspect of things or believe that the worst will happen.
Don't be such a pessimist; things will get better.

A person who treats disease, injury, or deformity by physical methods.
My physiotherapist helped me recover from my knee injury.

A person who pretends to be something they are not.
He's just a poser trying to impress everyone.

The acting out of a past event.
They performed a historical reenactment of the battle.

A device worn over the mouth and nose to prevent the inhalation of harmful substances, or for artificial respiration.
Workers in dusty environments should wear a respirator.

A book containing the rules of a game or activity.
You should always follow the rulebook.

A genus of plants in the mint family, including sage.
The garden was filled with colorful salvia plants.

A sleeveless athletic shirt or an undershirt.
He wore a white singlet under his shirt.

a long piece of wood or metal used for holding pieces of food together, especially while cooking them.
He put the meat and vegetables on a skewer before grilling them.

a person who sends unwanted email, especially advertisements.
My inbox is full of messages from spammers.

a young actress who is promoted as a future star.
The young starlet hoped to win an Oscar someday.

the quality of being strange or unusual.
The strangeness of the situation made everyone uncomfortable.

a large marine fish with a long, sword-like upper jaw.
We ordered grilled swordfish for dinner.

the act of acquiring or receiving something; often used in phrases like "for the taking" meaning available to be taken.
The opportunity was there for the taking.

a fishing boat that uses a trawl net or nets.
The trawler returned to port with a large catch of fish.

A person who does not believe in a particular religion or in religious belief in general.
He was an unbeliever in the supernatural.

An underlying feeling or influence, especially one contrary to the prevailing atmosphere.
There was an undercurrent of tension in the room.

The art or process of making video films.
Her passion is wedding videography.

a postponement or suspension of a meeting or session to another time or place
The judge announced the adjournment of the trial until Monday.

a device for spraying paint or other liquid by means of compressed air
The artist used an airbrush to create smooth gradients in the painting.

a sport in which participants eliminate opponents by hitting them with spherical plastic projectiles launched from replica firearms
They spent the weekend playing airsoft in the woods.

the state or condition of having no hair on the head
Male pattern baldness is a common condition.

a building containing baths for public use
They relaxed in the traditional Japanese bathhouse.

the activity of owning and raising bees
Beekeeping has become a popular hobby in recent years.

romantic or sexual attraction to both men and women
The discussion focused on understanding bisexuality and its representation.

a person or thing that blooms or flourishes
She was a late bloomer in her career, finding success in her forties.

a person who earns money to support their family
In many families, both parents are now breadwinners.

the act of providing care for someone
Caregiving can be a demanding but rewarding role.

a weight that balances another weight
The crane used a large counterweight to maintain stability.
